notes: Desktop/set-top streaming puck; no rack units apply. Model is the 2024 Roku Ultra (streaming player, SKU 4850X); a "Roku Ultra LT" variant exists with lesser specs but is a separate product. Single HDMI 2.1b output carries video + digital audio (Dolby Atmos decode, DTS pass-through) — there is no separate optical/analog audio output or microSD slot on this generation. USB is USB-A 3.0 (SuperSpeed, 5 Gbps) used for local media playback, functionally host-only in practice but the connector is bidirectional-capable so classified as such per the USB-A convention. Power is a proprietary/generic 12V DC barrel adapter (not USB-C PD) confirmed by both the manufacturer spec page and third-party replacement-adapter listings. Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) is also present but omitted here as it is not a physical port.
